# ViMax callback wiring repair 03

Date: 2026-10-23. Scope: internal LangChain request gating, response/parse correlation, offline tests and code-only image derivative. No real API, credentials, generation task, image/video job or formal attempt was used.

## Findings and repairs

1. **Callback exceptions could be swallowed by the locked LangChain dispatcher.** The registered v5 image contains `langchain-core 0.3.86`. Its `handle_event` / `_ahandle_event_for_handler` logs callback exceptions and rethrows only when `handler.raise_error` is true; async dispatch executes callbacks inline only when `handler.run_inline` is true. `_LedgerChatCallbackHandler` now sets both flags. The final tests invoke actual `ChatOpenAI.invoke/ainvoke` through this callback manager and a fake HTTP transport, so the property is validated through dispatch.
2. **Check-then-increment had a concurrency race, and an open-event write failure was swallowed.** `RequestLedger.reserve_and_open()` now checks deadline and all requested caps, increments `llm_calls`/`llm_attempts`, and persists the pre-send `open` record while holding the ledger lock. A failed required write raises `LedgerWriteError`; the consumed reservation fails closed. `LedgerWriteError` joins budget/deadline exceptions as a non-recoverable control exception, so the planning wrapper, tool route and AgentLoop stop without recovery sends. SDK retries remain `max_retries=0`; project retry policy is unchanged.
3. **Parse diagnostics relied on context-local/shared-current correlation.** The callback now maps each LangChain `run_id` under a lock, attaches the request ID to that response's generation and returned message metadata, and removes the mapping on close/error. The parser reads only metadata on the exact generation/message; absent metadata stays `null`. A task-done hook converts callback-less async cancellation into a right-censored ledger error and clears the pending map. Response text redaction, 16,000-character bound, truncation flag, finish reason and usage remain in place. Parse success and parse failure diagnostics include the request ID when the exact response carries it.

## Validation

Final validation ran **24 tests, 24 passed**, inside the new image with `network=none`, read-only root, `--rm`, and read-only test fixtures. This includes the previous 14 regressions and 9 actual callback integration tests. Coverage includes cap=0, expired deadline, ledger write failure, concurrent calls sharing one remaining slot (two separate threads through the real model), successful persisted request, actual LangChain async malformed-JSON parsing, concurrent interleaved success/error, sequential error then success, missing server response, cancellation/right-censoring, and a real ViMax planning tool → `_run_planning_step` → registry/tool executor → AgentLoop stop path. Fake HTTP sends were zero for every pre-send gate case. The authoritative final log is [tests-final-image-v2.log](tests-final-image-v2.log). A first candidate image (`...callback-fixes-01`) passed 23 tests, then a final review found that an unconfigured ledger path still allowed a non-persisted request. That case now fails closed, has its own regression, and the candidate was superseded without overwriting it. To align one pre-existing callback unit fixture with the actual LangChain callback contract, its synthetic `on_llm_end` call supplies the `run_id` and parser generation metadata; the original fixture is preserved in `snapshots/pre-change/`. Prior raw and reports remain unchanged. To align one pre-existing callback unit fixture with the actual LangChain callback contract, its synthetic `on_llm_end` call now supplies the `run_id` and parser generation metadata; the original fixture is preserved in `snapshots/pre-change/`. Prior test logs and historical run evidence remain unchanged.

Iteration logs 01–05 preserve the initial harness and integration failures; the corrective changes were limited to fake-ledger API alignment, parser fixture metadata, model response metadata propagation and cancellation cleanup. The final log is authoritative. No real task workflow was run.

## Boundaries and next step

The callback dispatch, atomic pre-send gate (including an absent ledger path), and request-to-parse association are now verified offline on the delivered image. Real provider behavior, remote usage consistency, real planning quality/schema compliance, HTTP transport count and billing remain unverified. One bounded real planning validation still needs separate approval, a fresh identity, a hard logical-call cap and wall deadline; it should stop before image/video generation. No approval, attempt or raw run was created here.
